notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.1
notes.notes:
This patch brings fixes for some of the bigger bugs left behind in the wake of the Apocalypse, as well as some quality-of-life changes for combat.

[list]
[*] Added a single-card discard for 1 pip of action time. Click a card in your hand twice to discard it. You can also now deselect the active card by right clicking.
[*] Fixed a bug where cards in the crafting screen would show the wrong descriptions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the world map could be clicked through the craft screen. 
[*] Reduced the density of rifts in the late game to congest those battles slightly less.
[*] Re-added a grid to the battle map, with slight visual tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.0.1
notes.notes:
The Apocalypse patch seems to have left difficulty a bit on the high side, so these changes are intended to rein that in a little.
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Tendrils are supposed to be a nuisance, but ended up feeling impossible to counter. Tendrils now attack in a cross AOE rather than a square to make their attackable area smaller and more intuitive; their attack is more costly, giving them more downtime; and they spawn with less turn progress, so killing them feels like a potential reprieve instead of totally pointless.
[*] Global enemy health scaling has been slightly reduced. The last patch made finding a safe opening to attack much more challenging, so it should take fewer good attacks to take down a foe.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.0.1
notes.notes:
Tweaks and bug fixes to sand down some of the rough edges of the Apocalypse patch!

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Clone Craft essence requirement: 2 -> 0. Compared to the other orbs, Clone was unrewarding under almost all circumstances. Now it'll be worth picking up most of the time, like the others.
[*] Corrupted Warp cost: 3 -> 2.
[*] Corrupted Gravitas cost: 4 -> 3.
[*] Added an essence counter to the Crafting icon. (This was actually in the last patch but I forgot to add it to the notes :p)
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing RNG to not use the run's base seed.
[*] Made the Lurker's AI more aggressive to reduce pointless use of Corrupted Warp.
[*] Fixed a text overflow issue with card history entries.
[*] Fixed a text scaling issue with end of fight drops.
[*] Fixed a bug where dying tentacles would briefly appear alive before disappearing.
[*] Reduced the size of the hoverable area for card history previews to make them less likely to obscure the map.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.5.0: Apocalypse, Part 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update brings the Corruption system to the game, as well as a huge slew of visual improvements and reworks. As you progress through a run, Corruption will unpredictably alter the spaces you travel and the enemies you encounter. You'll have to learn new strategies and adapt on the fly to overcome the forces of (dun dun dun) THE APOCALYPSE!

This is the biggest and flashiest update to date, introducing mechanics that drastically alter the flow of a run and enhancing the overall look of the game in major ways. My goal with future patches is to build on the systems and themes introduced in this update to do more narrative story-telling and further develop the world where the game takes place. Stay tuned for Apocalypse Part 2! As usual, I'll be taking feedback on how to make the game better on [url=https://discord.gg/AdDwuMCwWf]the Discord![/url]

Features:
[list]
[*] Added the Corruption system to the game, which replaces the old Threat difficulty scaling paradigm. Corruption will open up impassable rifts that tighten the combat and exploration spaces, give enemies special cards that alter their combat abilities, and summon implacable Tendrils into battle. Eventually, an unending storm of corruption drains the player's health with every step.
[*] Added brand music themes for high-Corruption battle, high-Corruption exploration, and boss battles.
[*] Added a list of recently played enemy cards to the battle UI.
[*] Reworked the mountain map entirely.
[*] Reworked the visual effect for enemy death.
[*] Reworked the visual effect for delayed impact abilities.
[*] Reworked the enemy card icon for ranged attack abilities the be more obvious (it's a bow now).
[*] Reworked the overall look and presentation of the world map.
[*] Removed the overlay grid for battle to improve battle readability.
[*] Tweaked the visual layouts and general aesthetics of several battle maps.
[/list]

Fixes: 
[list]
[*] Changed most of the text in the game to draw from a smaller pool of fonts.
[*] Changed the turn progress indicator when selecting a unit to show a percentage (towards taking a turn).
[*] Shortened multiple tutorials that were too verbose.
[*] Fixed a longstanding bug where the tutorial after beating a boss never appeared.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.3.1
notes.notes:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Tweaked the reworked spawn algorithm to reduce the likelihood of spawning into a giant dogpile of melee units.
[*] Tweaked the AI of most units to slightly improve their pathing behavior. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.3
notes.notes:
Rolling out a few more fixes and balance changes before starting on the next big update, including some changes that will make the game harder across all difficulties! 

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Reworked the algorithm for enemy placement to put enemies at their ideal ranges more frequently, i.e. melee enemies will spawn closer and ranged enemies farther away.
[*] Fixed a long-standing numerical error that was making the player significantly faster than intended.  
[*] Corrected grammar in the description for backstep effects.
[*] Tweaked the relative size and positions of crafting screen elements to make visuals more consistent across different resolutions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Sentry's Magnetic Mark could cause a turn lock.
[*] Fixed a bug where tutorial text could appear clipped off the screen on the world map.
[*] Flattened and simplified parts of the Tundra and Desert battle maps to make clicking around them less awkward.
[*] Fixed a bug where a sliver of black screen was appearing in the main menu.
[*] Berserker's Furious Rush: +20% damage -> +10% damage
[*] Juggernaut's Heavy Footfalls: 4 cost -> 5 cost
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.2
notes.notes:
More bug fixes and tweaks, including some long-needed improvements to minion pathfinding.

Big thank you to everyone who sent feedback through the in-game tool! I also wanted to specifically call out to the person who asked about accessibility features; unfortunately that was beyond the scope of these small pre-thanksgiving-break fixes, but I will be looking at ways to make the game more usable for you soon. Thanks again to everyone for playing, and hope to see you all on the [url=https://discord.gg/AdDwuMCwWf]Discord![/url] I'll be sharing WIP content as well as gathering your feedback on ways to improve the game and on what kind of content you'd like to see in the future.

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Removed the target requirement for Shadow's Convergent Assault to avoid situations where generated cards can clog the player's hand. (It still requires allied summons to have any effect, though.)
[*] Fixed a bug where cards copied by Mimic's Emulate were not being consumed after use.
[*] Added a visual delay to attract VFX to better synchronize with card effects.
[*] Fixed a bug where summoned allies would confuse enemies and allies for pathfinding purposes.
[*] Fixed a bug where summoned allies would path unintuitively when facing multiple enemies.
[*] Made healing full-health allies a less appealing option for the enemy AI.
[*] Tweaked the Warchief's AI to summon totems more frequently.
[*] Fixed incorrect VFX for Zephyr's Sudden Gust.
[*] Changed enemy buff visuals to align vertically (for real this time).
[*] Synchronized the visuals of Totem pulses with their effects.
[*] Fixed a bug where the indicator for 'enemy will take turn' would stay on after the enemy took its turn.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.1
notes.notes:
Bug fixes for the Ruins update!

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would lock the game after killing the owner of a delayed effect.
[*] Fixed a bug where Maintain Proximity didn't require a target.
[*] Reversed the visual stacking order of cards to improve readability of large hands.
[*] Fixed a bug where Ice Spikes could block cell clicks.
[*] Shrunk the Mortar's deck token.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.4.0: That Belongs in a Museum
notes.notes:
[b]RUINS UPDATE![/b]
Hello everyone! Unfortunately ya boi got COVID half way through the development cycle and had to scale down a bit, but nonetheless this patch brings the first batch of new content to the game! There's a new biome to discover in the overworld, a new map to battle on, and 5 new enemies (which means 15 new cards)! I've tried to bring fresh new playstyles into the game with each new foe. As usual, thanks for playing, and let me know what you think on the [url=https://discord.gg/AdDwuMCwWf]Discord![/url]

[b]Features: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ruins tile to the overworld and its corresponding battle map.
[*] Added delayed-activation effects. They appear as a glowing outline on the ground with a line of pips above them, which indicate the AOE and timer for the effect, respectively.
[*] Added the Lurker, an agile melee attacker who drags foes to their doom.
[*] Added the Prophet, a mystic capable of predicting falling rubble or striking the entire map simultaneously.
[*] Added the Mortar, which peppers the battlefield with countless quickly-falling blasts.
[*] Added the Sentry, a durable melee attacker that draws foes in and pummels the area around it.
[*] Added the Dynamo, an unpredictable melee attacker that strikes more times with each repetition.
[*] Added two items that reward a high deck size, one of which summons a Boss to help you fight!
[*] Added visible names for all passive items.
[/list]

[b]Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Made the crafting token for totem enemies a totem rather than a leaf.
[*] Parrying Slice: Damage Reduction 50% => 75%
[*] Fixed floating damage numbers to cluster more naturally in groups.
[*] Added SFX when right-clicking items in the crafting screen.
[*] Fixed the world map pathfinding preview to behave more intuitively.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.1
notes.notes:
Minor bug fixes!
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Halo Slime would get stuck in a walking animation when moving one tile.
[*] Fixed a bug where the floating damage number for shield was too light to see.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPC buffs would appear horizontally instead of vertically.

notes.title: Update v0.3.0: Ooh, Shiny
notes.notes:
Hello! This update is a bit of a variety pack aimed at improving the game's UI clarity and overall responsiveness. I've added several animations, floating damage numbers and hit-state to make combat more readable and responsive, VFX for crafting and the deck view, and more! With a chunk of the QOL wishlist out of the way, the next patch will focus more on content.

Thanks again to everyone who's playing! If you enjoy the game, come talk to me about it on the [url=https://discord.gg/AdDwuMCwWf]Discord[/url]!

Features:
[list]
[*] Added floating numbers for health, block, and shield damage, as well as healing.
[*] Added new animations for melee attack, damage taken, and walking.
[*] Added a visual flash to units when taking damage.
[*] Rearranged enemy unit UI to a more compact layout and tweaked visuals.
[*] Rebalanced all difficulties to make early fights more challenging and reduce enemy damage scaling in the late game.
[*] Added a custom mouse cursor for the game.
[*] Added a slider for enemy turn length and tweaked the visuals of the options window.
[*] Added VFX to emphasize the results of the Gamble and Clone crafts.
[*] Brightened the Halo Slime's colors to make it stand out more from the others.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Clone craft would consume ingredients without cloning.
[*] Fixed a bug (probably) where enemy cards would render over their info tags.
[*] Fixed a visual bug with Advancing Brawl.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.2.0: Deeper Exploration
notes.notes:
[h1]UPDATE[/h1]
Hello everyone! One of the more common points of feedback I've received is that the overworld/exploration portion of the game feels not very interactive/repetitive/not interesting enough. I agree! To start remedying that, [i]this update makes mountains and water tiles into blocking terrain[/i] on the world map. Instead of passing through them freely, you'll have to search the shores/foothills for [b]two new vehicles[/b] that will help you traverse them. My hope is that this will make the world map terrain feel more meaningful and less decorative, and make the challenge of navigation feel more meaningful.

The second major feature in this update is the addition of [b]orbs[/b](pending a better name..?) to the map, which provide a single-use chance to cash in some essences for one of three different special rewards, with different rules and different requirements. My hope is that by giving players a broader variety of uses for essences, I can tighten the game's overall essence economy, offer meaningful decisions to players, and feature more variety in runs.

Finally, I have continued to buff boss cards to make them feel more exciting as player abilities. Boss cards should feel impactful and good to play generally, and the small number of them available throughout a run means that they should feel like an exciting and powerful addition to your deck... for the right build, of course ;). As such, I'm going to be making the less exciting boss cards stronger and reduce boss scaling where appropriate to maintain a similar difficulty level but make the player's reward more appealing.

TL:DR vehicles, special-craft pickups, better boss cards.

If you're enjoying the game, come talk to me about it on the  [url=https://discord.gg/AdDwuMCwWf]Discord![/url] As usual, thanks for playing!

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

Features:
[list]
[*] Made mountains and water unpathable and added their respective vehicles: the balloon and the boat.
[*] Added three orbs to the game: Consume (Red), Clone (Green), and Gamble (Yellow). They allow you to sacrifice essences for stats, create a copy of an essence you own, or reroll an essence with a chance for a boss essence, respectively.
[*] Reworked the Shadow Boss with a new card that summons multiple illusions simultaneously and lower costed abilities across the board. 
[/list]

Minor changes and fixes: 
[list]
[*] Fixed world tile selection to be more responsive after pathing.
[*] Made sleeper start with slightly more turn energy.
[*] Added colored words to the tutorial for emphasis.
[*] Added tutorials for the new systems (orbs and vehicles).
[*] Fixed a bug with the discord icon's stacking order.
[*] Fixed a bug where deck tutorial could not be completed.
[*] Rebalanced Suffocating Presence to inflict more speed reduction but repeat fewer times.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.3
notes.notes:
More small tweaks and fixes. With the majority of the glaring bugs and easily-resolvable issues (hopefully) out of the way, I can turn my focus to adding new features and content! And to anyone reading this, I'd love to hear from you on the discussion page or through the ingame form. Thanks for playing!

[list]
[*] Fixed a variety of bugs caused when dragging essences into eachother on the crafting screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that was making tiles less responsive in battle when under enemy UI elements.
[*] Changed the ally distinction effect to make it WAY more obvious which units are player-summoned.
[*] Added a glowing effect to the boss compass to make it more noticeable for new players.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.2
notes.notes:
Another patch, aimed at smoothing out the difficulty curve somewhat between normal encounters and bosses, explaining some mechanics that needed clarification, and of course, miscellaneous bug fixes. Thanks again to everyone who's playing the game!

[list]
[*] Rebalanced normal encounters to be slightly less frequent but contain slightly more enemies, with the goal of slightly reducing the overall inflow of resources and increasing the difficulty of normal encounters.
[*] Added an explanation in the tutorial for the connection between pip cost on cards and enemy turn speed.
[*] Added a gold background to boss essences to make them stand out more in a full inventory.
[*] Added a tutorial reminder for when the essence inventory is getting full to encourage players to craft.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could spawn on a pickup or enemy.
[*] Rebalanced the Warchief boss to make its cards more powerful, but reduced its stats significantly with the goal of making the encounter slightly more challenging and much more rewarding for the player.
[*] Zoomed out the camera in battle to make the edges of the map easier to interact with.
[*] Fixed a bug that could make enemy buff tooltips clip into terrain.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.1
notes.notes:
Minor bug fixes; big thanks to everyone who sent in bug reports! :)

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with card target type plaque that was causing Illusion Swap to improperly display as 'Target Enemy'.
[*] Fixed feedback box to properly wrap text.
[/list]
